items.title: This Is Class War
items.summary: The latest on the student protests in France, the art world’s AI problem, one-on-one with Rosana Paulino, and Beer With a Painter featuring Melissa Brown.

items.title: Portrait of a Paris Art Week on Fire
items.summary: On protest, business as usual, and the surreal experience of attending an art fair while smelling burning plastic.

items.title: How Art Can Deliver Justice for Refugees
items.summary: In the legal system, art created by refugees and incarcerated people can serve both as a form of therapy and as evidence of mass atrocities.

items.title: The War on Art Is Repeating Itself
items.summary: As an artist who lived through the Reagan-era Culture Wars, I recommend Isaac Butler’s “The Perfect Moment” for the stories that parallel our current fight to defend creative expression.
